newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Rad Data gets BBC contract.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Rad Data gets BBC contract.

text.p: BBC Scotland in Glasgow has chosen Rad Data Communication's MP-MLQ voice compression technology to give outside broadcast crews multiple voice links over a single ISDN circuit, the Israeli company said.
Rad did not disclose the value of contract. A company spokesman said it was "a one shot deal that could lead to other contracts as the network and its coverage expands".
Rad Data is a major manufacturer of data communications and telecommunications access products. It is the flagship company of Israel's Rad Group, which is comprised of 12 different companies.
